notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's year-end 2024 holdings data file ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); the same line in NBIM's equity CSV download (https://www.nbim.no/api/investments/v2/report/?assetType=eq&date=2024-12-31&fileType=csv) reads "North America;United States;Palo Alto Networks Inc;Technology;10876920313;957698786;0.8%;0.8%". CalPERS: the source is CalPERS's 13F-HR/A (restatement) for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, filed April 23, 2025; its information table is identical to the original 13F-HR filed February 12, 2025. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS: Palo Alto's FY2024 10-K cover (325.6 million shares, August 19, 2024) predates its two-for-one stock split of December 12, 2024, while CalPERS's December 31, 2024 holding is post-split, so the denominator is the cover page of the next post-split filing, the 10-Q for the quarter ended January 31, 2025 (rounded to 662.1 million).
